title: BENCHMARKING SEQUENTIAL VISUAL INPUT REASONING AND PREDICTION IN MULTIMODAL LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
reasoning: The paper introduces a novel benchmark and evaluation methods for assessing predictive reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) across various scenarios, including abstract pattern reasoning, human activity prediction, and physical interaction prediction. It does not contain any component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
